title: Ostomy Supply Program Convex Barrier Refills
content:
**Patient services desk guidance - Ostomy Supply Program.** Refills of the extended-wear skin barrier with built-in convexity (A4407) are shipped on their own refill rule.

## Scope

For a convex-barrier (A4407) refill this policy handles, and only for such a refill, the supply days are set as this policy states; every other refill keeps the supply days of a shipment as the tier's standard supply days per shipment, shortened to the whole 30-day blocks that remain before the authorization's valid-through date when fewer remain. For a convex-barrier (A4407) refill this policy handles, and only for such a refill, the units are set as this policy states; for every other refill the units of each item are the tier's monthly allowance for that item times the supply days divided by 30, or the written order's quantity when that is lower.

## Confirmation

For a convex-barrier (A4407) refill, on tiers where refill confirmation is required the refill ships only after the customer personally confirms to the representative, for this shipment and for the enrollment the representative names to them, that they are still using the item and how much supply they have on hand; every other refill on those tiers ships only after the customer personally confirms, for this shipment, that they are still using the item and how much supply they have on hand.

## Conditions on the records

- Where the extra barriers rest on no over-limit record, they are fixed only after the records carry a liability notice for the convex barrier signed on or after the newest written order's date.
- On a program whose past-due amount has reached the hold minimum, a refill is not shipped until the posting named on the most recently received approved hardship application carries its hardship waiver adjustment.

Each is a condition on what the program's records show: while the state it names is absent, the extra barriers are not fixed, or the refill is not shipped, as the sentence states.

## Effect of shipping

The refill is recorded on the enrollment's shipment history with the day's ship date, standard ground shipping, the supply days it covers, how it is billed and the date the customer confirmed the refill; the enrollment's billing units still authorized to ship fall by the units shipped.

## Shipping the refill: `ship_ostomy_refill_57098f77`

`ship_ostomy_refill_57098f77` is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`). It ships one refill package of one ostomy item on an Ostomy Supply Program enrollment, drawing the shipped billing units from one authorization grant.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ostomy_program_id` | The enrollment the refill ships on, read from the enrollment lookup | Identifier |
| `customer_id` | The customer who holds the enrollment, read from the customer profile lookup | Identifier |
| `coverage_id` | The insurance coverage record the enrollment bills, read from the enrollment or coverage lookup | Identifier; an empty string on the self-pay tier |
| `ostomy_order_id` | The authorization grant record the refill draws its units from, read from the order and authorization lookup of that enrollment | Identifier |
| `previous_ostomy_shipment_id` | The enrollment's previous refill shipment record of the same item, read from the shipment history lookup | Identifier; an empty string for a first fill |
| `item_code` | The HCPCS code of the item shipped | One of the values below |
| `units` | The billing units shipped (each barrier, pouch, belt or bedside drainage bag; per ounce of paste or adhesive remover); the physical pieces recorded equal the units | Whole number |
| `supply_days` | The days of supply the refill covers | Whole number of calendar days, a multiple of 30 |
| `billing_route` | How the shipped units are billed: `payer_claim` when the enrollment bills an insurance coverage and the refill is billed to that payer by claim; `self_pay` when the enrollment is on the self-pay tier and the customer is charged the cash price | One of the two values |
| `refill_confirmed_date` | The date the customer confirmed continued use and supply on hand for this refill | YYYY-MM-DD; an empty string when the tier requires no confirmation |

Values of `item_code`:

| Value | Item |
|---|---|
| `A4414` | Flat skin barrier with flange 4x4 in or smaller |
| `A4407` | Extended-wear skin barrier with built-in convexity |
| `A4409` | Extended-wear flat skin barrier |
| `A4416` | One-piece closed pouch with filter |
| `A4423` | Two-piece closed pouch for a locking-flange barrier |
| `A4424` | One-piece drainable pouch |
| `A4427` | Two-piece drainable pouch |
| `A4431` | One-piece urinary pouch with tap |
| `A4434` | Two-piece urinary pouch with tap |
| `A4406` | Pectin-based paste, per ounce |
| `A4455` | Adhesive remover, per ounce |
| `A4367` | Ostomy belt |
| `A4357` | Bedside drainage bag |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` ("shipped" when the refill was recorded), `ostomy_shipment_id` (the new shipment record), `ostomy_program_id`, `ostomy_order_id` (the grant drawn), `previous_ostomy_shipment_id` (the previous refill named), `item_code`, `units` (integer billing units), `supply_days` (integer days), `ship_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `billing_route` and `authorized_units_remaining` (the enrollment's integer billing units still authorized to ship after the refill). No other return is defined.
